scope: Actual standalone in-memory probe; no Team Notes application/DB mutation
command: docker run --rm --network none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 -e DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 -e DOTNET_CLI_HOME=/tmp -v "<temporary-copy-of-example>:/work" -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 sh -c 'set -e; dotnet restore Probe.csproj --ignore-failed-sources >/dev/null; dotnet build Probe.csproj -c Release --no-restore >/dev/null; dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/Probe.dll'
limitations: Reference probe, not production migration/login/reset-flow implementation
No Team Notes file, application DB/seed, Docker volume or main branch changed
